log.msg: LOOK done (headless, private :8097 server, playwright): all three lab indexes + 8 sub-pages, 400/1920/3440, zero console errors everywhere. Gallery index is nav-only (Lists/Answers/Cards); the actual card walls live one hop in (lists/building-blocks/ etc, 6-13 cards). Screens already had its round-2 (the 2026-08-29 composition pass IS round 2 - decisions.md documents it in full, nothing left dangling). Shells' Shell.js/Shell.css is one shared base for all ten pages.

BRAINSTORM, ranked (built = top 2): 1 BUILT gallery title filter over large lists (Layouts 13, Column shapes 9, Recipes 10) - client-side, over titles wall() already draws. 2 BUILT shells per-region keyboard toggles ([ ] h f) on the shared Shell.js base, free across all ten pages, with a title-tooltip affordance and the focused-input guard from /imagine/game/'s keyboard travel. 3 gallery read-state marks via page.store() on foreign cards - real but the mag/ pattern's payoff (you actually read the article) doesn't transfer to a doc-gallery checkmark at 6-13 items; cut. 4 shells 'everything' composed shell naming which lab page each region came from - good capstone but one new page vs #2's ten-pages-for-free leverage; roadmap. 5 gallery count badges in lists/ index (Layouts (13)) - cut, changes title -> changes slug -> breaks the url. 6 screens link the composition-pass measured numbers to each live experiment - decisions.md's table already does this; no gap found. 7 shells reset-all-chrome hotkey - unnecessary, same four keys already toggle back. 8 screens arrow-key hop nav - redundant with real browser Back on real urls. 9 gallery open-in-new-tab affordance - answered already by Answers/Arrange's re-addressing demo. 10 shells current-shell nav indicator - already live via Router.mark_links()'s .active/.in-path classes. 11 gallery site-wide .gal-flat card restyle - out of fence (Page.css), roadmap only. 12 screens keyboard arrow travel between hops - low value, cut.

BUILT 1/2 - gallery title filter: input above the wall on lists >8 cards, filters .page-preview by .page-preview-title text at each keystroke. Verified headless: Layouts 13->1 typing 'gallery', back to 13 on clear; Building-blocks (6 cards) correctly shows no filter box. Zero console errors 400/1920/3440 on all six list pages.

BUILT 2/2 - shells keyboard chrome toggles: [ ] h f hide/show left/right/head/foot as a class on .page.shell, never a second page. Found + worked around a real trap: activated()/deactivated() can't host a base-class hook here because Object.assign(this, literal) makes canvas/page.js's own activated() (its ResizeObserver) shadow Shell.prototype's outright - moved the listener into render(), the one method no leaf shell redeclares, scoped by .active-page so an unvisited shell's copy never fires. Verified headless: left rail hides/returns; canvas's four parts hide together and its own ResizeObserver readout moves 1504x908 -> 1920x1000 and back (the grid-arithmetic finding, proven live); a focused synthetic <input> blocks the toggle. Zero console errors, all touched pages, 400/1920/3440.

docs: one readme.md line per touched lab (gallery: filter behavior + threshold; shells: the four keys + hover-for-hint), plus a decisions.md section each (gallery: DOM-vs-data + closure-ordering reasoning; shells: the activated() shadowing trap, in full, since it will bite the next person who adds a hook this way).

assign.outcome: **Built the top 2 of 12 brainstormed improvements.** Gallery got a client-side title filter over its three big card walls (Layouts 13, Column shapes 9, Recipes 10) — `input()` above `wall()`, filtering `.page-preview` by `.page-preview-title` text, no store, no data model. Shells got keyboard chrome toggles — `[` `]` `h` `f` hide/show left/right/head/foot as a class on `.page.shell`, added once to the shared `Shell.js` base so all ten shells get it for free, with a hover tooltip and the focused-input guard from `/imagine/game/`'s keyboard travel. Found and worked around a real trap along the way: `activated()` can't host a base-class hook here because `Object.assign` in the constructor lets a leaf shell's own `activated()` (canvas's `ResizeObserver`) shadow the prototype's outright — the listener lives in `render()` instead, the one method no leaf redeclares. Verified headless (Playwright, private :8097 server): filter 13→1→13 on Layouts, no filter box on 6-card lists; left-rail toggle round-trips; canvas's own ResizeObserver readout measured 1504×908 → 1920×1000 with all four parts hidden and back; a focused synthetic `<input>` blocked the toggle. Zero console errors, every touched page, 400/1920/3440. **Roadmap:** an 'everything' composed shell naming which lab page each region came from (one page vs. the toggle's ten-for-free, so it waited); gallery read-state marks via `page.store()` (real, but a doc-gallery checkmark at 6-13 items didn't earn its keep the way `/imagine/mag/`'s 6-article read-count did); lifting `.gal-flat`'s card restyle site-wide (out of fence, `Page.css`). **Cut:** count badges on the Lists index (changing the title changes the slug, breaking the url); a chrome reset hotkey (redundant — the same four keys already toggle back); screens got no build — its 2026-08-29 composition pass already was round 2, and nothing in the lab's own notes named a gap.
